about: The days-left rounding both sides must agree on, max(1, ceil(pagesLeft ÷ pace)): the pace calculator's line (src/lib/pace.test.ts) and days_left on the server (backend/tests/test_pace_calculator.py). The pace is a decimal string as typed. Every case is under 60 days, so the line is in days. 21 @ 0.7, 21 @ 1.4 and 42 @ 1.4 are exact in Fractions but a day over with a naive float ceil. Change a case here and both suites must still pass.
